The user wants a list of Canadian public holidays (long weekends) for 2023. We can provide them directly; no tool needed.

We should give dates with day names, maybe mention if they fall on weekdays so they'd create long weekends. Provide all federal statutory holidays in Canada for 2023:

Good Friday – Apr 7 (Friday)
Easter Monday – Apr 10 (Mon) [not official but used by some employers]
Victoria Day – May 22 (Mon)
Canada Day – Jul 1 (Saturday)
Civic Holiday – Aug 14 (Mon) [Ontario etc.]
Labour Day – Sep 18 (Mon)
Thanksgiving – Oct 9 (Mon)
Remembrance Day – Nov 11 (Wed) (observed Mon‑Nov‑13)
Christmas Day – Dec 25 (Monday)
Boxing Day – Dec 26 (Tuesday)
